what is the student check-out policy?.question: What is the student check-out policy?

variants.answer:
Here is the student check-out policy for Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year:

- Parents/guardians must come to the office, provide a photo ID, and check their student out in person.
- Phone calls for leaving early are NOT accepted for student protection.
- Students must sign in/out at the Attendance Window when they leave/return.
- Due to the high volume of requests, parents/guardians should arrive at least 20 minutes BEFORE the time they need their student released.
- In-person early check outs after 2:45 pm will not be granted. After 2:45 pm, you must wait for your student to be dismissed at the normal time.
- Emails for early dismissal (sent before 10:30 AM) can be used to check students out at any time later in the day. These emails must include the student’s full legal name, ID#, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal.
- FOLLOW-UP NOTES documenting the reason for the absence are REQUIRED for excusing the absence created by early check-outs.

For full step-by-step instructions, please visit: [How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out).

If you need information not listed here, please contact the front office or refer to the [Staff Directory](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/directory). Let me know if you need further assistance!
